quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #4
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 35

questions.question: What is the speed limit in a residential area, unless posted otherwise?
questions.explanation: The speed limit in a residential area is 25 miles per hour, unless a different speed limit is posted.

questions.question: You are in the right lane of a multilane highway and want to move to the left lane. What should you do?

options.text: Check your rearview mirror for traffic behind you
Look over your left shoulder to check your blind spot
Check your side mirror and turn on your signal

questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors and look over your shoulder to make sure no vehicles are in your way. Always signal before you change lanes.

questions.question: What should you do at an intersection with a yield sign?

options.text: Always come to a complete stop
Yield only to traffic on the right
Yield only to traffic on the left
Slow down and let other traffic go first

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic in the intersection or on the road go first.

questions.question: What does it mean when you see an "Exit only" sign above your lane?

options.text: You can continue through or exit from your current lane
You can stay in your lane and continue through
You must exit if you stay in your current lane

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit if you stay in your current lane
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will end and become an exit ramp. You can change lanes to continue on the highway, or you must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.question: When changing lanes, what is important to do?

options.text: Make sure the lane is clear

questions.explanation: Always signal before changing lanes. Look over your shoulder to check your blind spot. Make sure the lane is clear before you move into it.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign tell you?

options.text: It warns about conditions on or near the road
It directs you to cities and towns ahead
It tells you about traffic laws and rules
It tells you about road construction ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns about conditions on or near the road
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs with black symbols on a yellow background are warning signs. They alert you to conditions on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: You have a green light at an intersection. Pedestrians are crossing against the red light. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up and pass in front of them
Stop and let them cross safely
Drive close to them to scare them

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let them cross safely
questions.explanation: Always be careful around pedestrians. Stop and let them cross safely, even if you have a green light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be present in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means an intersection is coming. Watch carefully for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: You are driving slowly and traffic is backing up behind you. What should you do?

options.text: Pull over to the right and let traffic pass
Do not let other cars pass

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over to the right and let traffic pass
questions.explanation: If you are driving much slower than other traffic on a two-lane road, you must pull off to the right and let vehicles pass. Only drive slowly when road conditions require it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells drivers to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs show traffic rules that you must follow. This sign tells drivers which direction they must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: If a train is close or moving fast enough to be dangerous, you must:

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Not cross the tracks until the train has completely passed.
Cross the tracks at your own risk.
Find an alternative route across tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not cross the tracks until the train has completely passed.
questions.explanation: Look and listen for trains before crossing railroad tracks. If a train is close or moving fast enough to be dangerous, do not cross. This is true even if there are no signals or the signals are not working.

questions.question: When you are in a line of traffic crossing a railroad track with no signals or gates:

options.text: You have the right-of-way and do not need to check for trains.
You may pass slower drivers while crossing the track.
You need to make sure there is space for your vehicle to get all the way across the tracks without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: You need to make sure there is space for your vehicle to get all the way across the tracks without stopping.
questions.explanation: When following another vehicle at a railroad crossing, make sure you have enough space to get all the way across the tracks before you drive onto them. Never try to pass another vehicle at or near a railroad crossing. Always check for trains before crossing any railroad tracks.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign tells drivers that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: Road rage and aggressive driving can be reduced by:
questions.explanation: As more drivers use the roads, road rage happens more often. To prevent road rage, use proper turn signals, obey speed limits, and allow plenty of time for your trip.

questions.question: Your tire blows out while driving. You should:

options.text: Hold your steering wheel tightly and slow to a stop.
Turn on your emergency flashers and continue driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold your steering wheel tightly and slow to a stop.
questions.explanation: If a tire blows out, do not immediately apply the brakes. Grip the steering wheel firmly and steer to stay in your lane. Slow down gradually by releasing the accelerator. Once you are moving slowly, apply the brakes lightly and pull off the road safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must bear to the right or to the left.

questions.question: Highway signs that tell drivers about dangerous conditions are called:
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to potential hazards ahead. Always follow warning signs for your safety. Ignoring a warning sign can cause an accident.

questions.question: Child restraints are required for:

options.text: Children under age 4 and/or weighing less than 40 pounds.
All children if the driver is their parent or guardian.
All children sitting in the front seat.
All children under age 6 when airbags are not available.

questions.correctAnswerText: Children under age 4 and/or weighing less than 40 pounds.
questions.explanation: Children under age 4 and/or weighing less than 40 pounds must use an approved child safety seat. Children ages 4 to 7 must use a booster seat, unless they are 4'9" or taller.

questions.question: When you see other drivers acting angry, you should:
questions.explanation: When other drivers are angry, distance yourself from them physically and mentally. Do not make eye contact or use gestures that might anger them. Slow down, move over, or do whatever keeps you safe.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.
A divided highway is starting. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Merge ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road will curve to the right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated on the sign.

questions.question: A driver license applicant under age ____ must have permission from a parent or guardian.
questions.explanation: If you are under 18, your parent or legal guardian must sign your driver license application.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for other vehicles and pedestrians to pass before going.

questions.question: If traffic lights at an intersection are not working:

options.text: Park off the road and wait for power to return.
Use hand signals to show other drivers what you plan to do.
Turn on hazard lights and go through without stopping.
Treat it like a four-way stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a four-way stop.
questions.explanation: When a traffic light is not working, treat the intersection as a four-way stop. Yield to other drivers as you would at a four-way stop, then proceed with caution.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
Come to a complete stop and give the right-of-way.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield if needed.
questions.explanation: A triangular sign means yield. Slow down and be ready to stop at the intersection. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at a railroad crossing. Trains cannot yield to cars, so you must let trains pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: At night when another vehicle is coming toward you, your headlights should be:

options.text: On either high or low beam.

questions.explanation: Do not use high beam headlights when another vehicle is coming toward you or when you are following another vehicle. Use low beam to keep everyone safe.

questions.question: You cannot pass other vehicles within ____ of a bridge, viaduct, or tunnel.
questions.explanation: You cannot pass other vehicles within 100 feet of a bridge, viaduct, or tunnel. Only pass when it is legal and safe.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves. Slow down and be prepared.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign means a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Drive with caution. Pedestrians may be in or near the road.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Be ready to adjust your speed and drive safely.

questions.question: On a traffic light, the colors from top to bottom are:
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic light, red is at the top and green is at the bottom. On a horizontal traffic light, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: You want to back out of your driveway. You see children playing nearby. What should you do first?

options.text: Rev your engine to warn the children.
Honk your horn so the children will hear you.
Walk to the back of your car to check that the way is clear.
Tell the children to stay away from the driveway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Walk to the back of your car to check that the way is clear.
questions.explanation: Always look through your back window before backing up. Do not rely only on mirrors. When children are near, get out and check behind your vehicle before you move.

questions.question: On slippery roads, you should:

options.text: Drive at the speed limit, but with caution.

questions.explanation: Slow down when it rains, snows, or sleets. These conditions make roads slippery. You may need to drive slower than the speed limit to stay safe.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a side road is coming up. Be ready for traffic entering from the side.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive below the speed limit?

options.text: When slow driving blocks the normal flow of traffic.
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone.
Only when driving in rural areas.

questions.correctAnswerText: When slow driving blocks the normal flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: Driving too slowly can be illegal if it stops normal traffic flow. You can receive a ticket for driving too slowly.

questions.question: When driving near heavy trucks, you must allow for:

options.text: The longer distance large vehicles need to stop.
The shorter distance large vehicles need to stop.
The lower noise from larger vehicles.
The higher speed of larger vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: The longer distance large vehicles need to stop.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles need more distance to stop than smaller vehicles. Stay in a position where the truck driver can see you. Do not block the truck driver's view of the road.
